item.title: Electrical Incident, Teen Drowning, Steve McKinney Dies
item.ns0:title: Electrical Incident, Teen Drowning, Steve McKinney Dies
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, three students suffer minor burns following a scary electrical incident at C.C. Sweeting Senior High School, prompting early dismissals and renewed union warnings over long-standing campus safety concerns. Tragic news hits New Providence as a 17-year-old boy drowns off South Sea Estates while swimming with friends, and police investigate a fatal morning motorcycle crash on Gladstone Road. Meanwhile, tributes pour in from across the nation honoring the life and legacy of pioneering broadcaster Steve McKinney Senior, as local drivers feel the pinch with gas prices climbing past $7 a gallon. Plus, we bring you updates on suspected impetigo cases in classrooms, court developments, and the inspiring journey of a Bahamian pianist who transformed adversity into national pride—tune in for these headlines, local sports, and your full weather forecast!
